projects.title: RoktoLagbe
projects.tagline: Real-Time Emergency Blood Donation & Network Platform
projects.stack: Next.js • TypeScript • Node.js • Express • Redis • Cloudinary
projects.description: A real-time emergency blood donation network connecting donors with hospitals and organizations for critical response.
projects.longDescription: RoktoLagbe is a comprehensive platform designed to streamline blood donation and handle emergency blood requests anywhere in Bangladesh. It bridges the gap between individual donors and institutional managers like hospitals and blood banks. The system features real-time emergency request tracking, donor availability management, organizational inventory management, and a robust verification system for institutional users. Built with a modern tech stack, it provides dedicated dashboards for donors, managers, and administrators, ensuring secure role-specific access, comprehensive analytics, and immediate, life-saving notifications when seconds matter.
features: Institutional Dashboard for Hospitals and Organizations
Secure Manager Verification and Audit System
Anonymized Public Search for Blood Requests and Donors
Advanced Analytics and Activity History Logging
Responsive Web Application with Modern UI

projects.title: RankNexis
projects.tagline: Strategic Agency Operations Hub & Atomic CMS
projects.stack: Next.js 15 • TypeScript • Tailwind CSS • Framer Motion • Cloudinary
projects.description: Strategic agency operations hub engineered for dynamic content orchestration, case studies, and operational governance.
projects.longDescription:
RankNexis is an advanced operational platform designed to bridge high-end software engineering with strategic growth marketing. Built on the Next.js App Router and Prisma, it features a custom-engineered Atomic CMS that enables fluid layout orchestration through a recursive section architecture. The system establishes industry authority via data-dense case studies and a clustered SEO blog strategy, all while maintaining strict design system integrity.

The administrative infrastructure provides deep-level governance, featuring multi-role access control, granular permission management, and comprehensive audit integrity logs for all high-stakes operations. Integrated telemetry nodes provide real-time server health and marketing intelligence, ensuring the platform functions as a scalable command center for business growth and operational reliability.
features: Atomic CMS with Recursive Section Orchestration
Strategic Lead Capture & Inquiry Management Node
Clustered SEO Content Architecture & Blog CMS
Data-Dense Case Studies with Impact Visualization
Streamlined Careers Portal & Talent Acquisition Sync
High-Performance Framer Motion UI with Glassmorphism

projects.title: Protidin Shokal
projects.stack: Next.js • TypeScript • Node.js • Express • Redis • Cloudinary
projects.description: High-performance digital news platform engineered for large-scale editorial operations, fast caching, and SEO publishing.
projects.longDescription:
Protidin Shokal is a production-grade news and media platform built to handle high-traffic publishing environments similar to leading online newspapers. It combines a powerful Next.js frontend with server-side rendering and incremental static regeneration to ensure blazing-fast load times and maximum SEO visibility.

The backend leverages Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis caching, and Elasticsearch to efficiently manage concurrent users, trending content, and instant search queries. A comprehensive editorial dashboard allows reporters, editors, and moderators to collaborate through structured workflows, while integrated advertisement management and analytics tools enable monetization and performance tracking.

Designed with scalability in mind, the platform supports dynamic categories, live news feeds, multimedia galleries, and interactive user features such as comments and bookmarks.

projects.title: FruitsZone ERP
projects.description: Scalable ERP system for fruit and agro businesses, enabling real-time inventory control, sales, and analytics.
projects.longDescription:
FruitsZone ERP is a production-ready enterprise resource planning system tailored for fruit and agro-based businesses. It digitizes and automates core business operations including inventory management, sales and purchase tracking, supplier and customer handling, and financial reporting.

The platform provides real-time stock synchronization, ensuring accurate inventory across all operations, while automated invoicing and order management streamline daily workflows. A centralized dashboard offers actionable insights through analytics and reports, helping business owners optimize decision-making and reduce operational inefficiencies.

Built with a modern, scalable architecture, the system supports role-based access control, ensuring secure usage for admins, staff, and managers. Its responsive UI ensures seamless usability across devices, making it suitable for both office and on-field operations.

projects.title: West Bound Travels
projects.stack: Next.js • TypeScript • Express.js • PostgreSQL • Redis • SSLCommerz
projects.description: Luxury houseboat booking platform in Tanguar Haor featuring real-time availability, secure payments, and admin management.
projects.longDescription:
West Bound Travels delivers a high-end booking experience for eco-luxury houseboat tourism in Sunamganj wetlands. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL + Prisma, and Express.js, it includes:

• 4 premium houseboats with detailed golden-themed room configurations
• Concurrent-safe real-time booking engine
• SSLCommerz payments (bKash, Nagad, credit/debit cards)
• Email OTP verification & password reset flow
• User dashboard with booking history & downloadable invoices
• Admin panel for fleet, destinations, blogs, gallery & static pages
• Automated transactional emails
• Cloudinary image management
• Responsive luxury UI with golden accents

Deployed on Vercel with high-availability cloud infrastructure.
features: Secure SSLCommerz Payment Gateway (bKash, Nagad, Cards)
Responsive Luxury Design with Custom Golden Palettes
Cloudinary Smart Media Optimization & CDN Delivery

projects.title: Newsx
projects.stack: Next.js • Express.js • MongoDB • TipTap • Cloudinary • Vercel
projects.description: Modern social blogging platform featuring rich-text publishing, 5-level nested comments, and real-time notifications.
projects.longDescription:
Newsx is a production-grade full-stack social blogging application that combines the best of modern web development practices. Built with Next.js and React on the frontend, and a robust Express.js + MongoDB backend, it delivers a fast, responsive, and engaging user experience.

The platform supports full user authentication with JWT access/refresh tokens, email verification, and secure password reset flows. Users can write beautiful posts using TipTap rich text editor, upload images via Cloudinary, engage through likes/dislikes on posts and comments, and build communities by following other authors.

A standout feature is the deeply nested commenting system (up to 5 levels) and real-time notification system. The admin dashboard provides complete control: suspend users/content, view analytics, and manage the entire platform. Comprehensive account deletion ensures all user data is permanently removed.

The entire API is fully documented with Swagger UI and deployed as serverless functions on Vercel.
features: Full JWT Authentication with Refresh Tokens
Global Full-Text Search across Posts & Users

projects.title: BD Martify
projects.stack: Next.js • Clerk • MongoDB • Mongoose • Cloudinary • Tailwind CSS
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce storefront with Clerk authentication, persistent cart, order workflows, and admin CRUD controls.
projects.longDescription:
BD Martify is a modern e-commerce application demonstrating a robust full-stack implementation using the T3 Stack principles. The project leverages Next.js for a highly performant, responsive user experience optimized for both desktop and mobile devices. Clerk is utilized for secure, scalable user authentication and management, providing dedicated user and admin accounts.

The application features a comprehensive user interface where customers can browse products, utilize a persistent shopping cart, manage their orders, and update their profiles. The back-end is powered by Mongoose for seamless data management and storage in a MongoDB database, handling product data, orders, and user information efficiently. Cloudinary is integrated for image hosting and asset management.

A dedicated admin panel facilitates complete control over the store's inventory, enabling administrators to perform C.R.U.D. operations on products and manage incoming orders.
